threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest Tube, but all the old-timers know it's quicker to walk and catch the 48 bus instead.
Last night, saw a group of lads on the 35 bus trading old mixtapes like they were gold. One even had a Walkman. Strange times.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw the kid in a dinosaur costume ride a bike past the Späti at 2 AM, I knew I’d found my place.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kiosk serving 24-hour snacks alongside creative graffiti art, making late-night cravings an artful experience.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can spot a tourist in line at Bi-Rite from a mile away. No one else takes that long to choose a flavor.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that was literally rolling backward down the hill. Driver was unfazed, just waved at us like it was normal.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the best tapas are at the popular spots. In Gràcia, the hidden bars serve the most authentic, soul-satisfying dishes, no lines.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they double-check every menu for English. Locals just point and order, no fuss.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the road when the buses are on strike. Everyone else just walks in the street like it’s a normal Tuesday.
Last Thursday, I saw a guy trying to sell a live goldfish on the 196. Said it would bring good luck. The fish didn't look too happy about it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw the same balcony cat sunbathing every day, as the neighbor changed their plants with the seasons. That's home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night kebab joint that serves up fresh salads topped with crispy falafel and a side of techno beats.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their nonchalant reaction to the BART delays. While newcomers panic, we just pull out our phones and check the next bus. It’s a way of life.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus this morning with a stray dog on board, just sitting there like it owned the place. Typical San Francisco vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always flock to Park Güell, but they miss the quiet charm of Plaça del Sol. It's where we really unwind, not at those overcrowded spots.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the lack of pedestrian crossings on Gran Via. They wait for traffic lights like it’s New York.
